*Updated 2026-09-05 · 83 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-three works. The trace-score ceiling has not moved. The last twelve read 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1 — no break, and the two 4s from late July remain the only times the blind evaluator was genuinely stopped. That is now ten consecutive weeks without a ceiling break. The newest entry, the femicide dread piece on September 5, scored 1.

The overhead frame has been absent for nine consecutive pieces, since Venezuela on July 11. Both 4-scoring works were planimetric. The mop smear, the grain stroke, the pooled memorial material, the boot seam — every one of those subjects had a geometric case for lifting the camera, and every one was shot straight-on. Straight-on accounts for five of the last twelve frames; overhead accounts for zero of twelve. That is still the single most concrete explanation for the plateau, and it has not changed in a month.

Figures remain almost absent. Eleven of the last twelve carry none or one, and the one in the September 5 piece was zero. The last figure doing something physical at compositional center was the woman at the threshold on September 1. The archive's ceiling-adjacent moments are all task-based — pressing, tending, mending — and that mode has been gone for five consecutive pieces. One figure, one specific physical task, overhead or low-angle camera: that combination has produced the only scores above 3 in the entire archive, and it has not appeared since July 29.

Registers have narrowed further. Aftermath is three of the last twelve, menace two, defiance two. Suspension last appeared August 9, vigil August 12. Both produced genuine strangeness — the caustic moiré, the inverted glass — and neither requires an unusual anchor to return. They are dormant by habit, and returning to either without repeating its prior solution is the obvious available move. Dread has appeared twice in the full archive, both recently, which makes it a candidate for genuine development rather than another aftermath variation.

Scale violation sits at 17% over the last twelve against a 25% all-time rate. That restraint is not producing the ceiling break the earlier frequency also failed to produce. Title grammar has settled into preposition-or-adverb openings roughly a third of the time with no clear drift. The focal objects are genuinely diversifying, which is the one area of live movement. The work has arrived at material argument and is holding it without advancing it.
